planet.name: Arkadia
planet.summary: Arkadia's newcomer route runs passport, A New Home starter kit, the puny islands and IFN training. Arkadia Underground (via the teleporter dropdown) and Arkadia Moon (a separate space destination) are covered here as activities. The main repeatables earn Arkadia Insignias, with Arkoins as a separate currency.
planet.howToReach: Shared warp to Arkadia Space Station (Kronan boards at Celeste Quarry or Twin Peaks), then the free station-to-planet teleporter; or a token teleport (6 station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet Teleportation Tokens on eligible links since 19.2.0); or your own ship with a thruster.
warnings: Desk-checked from public sources only; in-game field verification is pending.
Arkadia Moon travel (current Moon-to-planet fee, any reverse route), Moon entry and taxes, Oratan and Insignia clock triggers and Viceroy availability are unconfirmed.
Whether passport and IFN gates are identical for returning and planet-born avatars is unverified.
Space routes can cross lootable PvP zones. Leave lootable materials in storage.

activities.title: Get to Arkadia
activities.summary: Take a shared warp to Arkadia Space Station and use the station-to-planet teleporter, or teleport with Teleportation Tokens. Kronan runs a Calypso–Arkadia service boarding at Celeste Quarry or Twin Peaks.
steps: Shared warp: check Kronan's schedule (boarding at Celeste Quarry or Twin Peaks) and ask the operator for the current fare and cargo rules.
Token teleport: since 19.2.0 the published fare is 6 Teleportation Tokens station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet on eligible links. 150 kg cap.
From Arkadia Space Station, the teleporter down to the planet has no fee since 18.9.
Flying yourself needs a thruster. Leave lootable materials in storage and check the PvP map first.

cost.text: 6 or 10 Teleportation Tokens on eligible links, an operator's warp fare, or own ship fuel and decay.

currencies.name: Teleportation Token
currencies.note: 6 station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet on eligible links.

score.rationale: Required first step; token fares are low and no ship is needed.

warnings: Shared-warp fares and cargo rules are set by the operator; ask before boarding.
Lootable PvP zones in space can cost you cargo.

activities.title: Arkadia Passport Verification
activities.summary: Visitors from other planets start by getting their passport verified at the New Arrivals Hangar, handing in 10,000 Vibrant Sweat.
steps: Go to the Passport Officer at the New Arrivals Hangar (waypoint below).
Hand in 10,000 Vibrant Sweat.
rewards: Passport verification, opening the Arkadia newcomer route
requirementsText: Offworld visitor (it is unconfirmed whether planet-born or returning avatars face the same gate)

cost.text: 10,000 Vibrant Sweat.
cost.markupNote: Sweat can be gathered yourself or bought from players.

score.rationale: First step of the recommended Arkadia route for offworld visitors.

warnings: The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'; the label here is the research's.

activities.title: A New Home (starter kit)
activities.summary: Advisor Nina at the IFN Supply Depot sends you around the medical, weapon, armor and clothing stores to collect a starter kit: training weapons, a first-aid pack, mining starter tools, ammo and probes, and the Exploration Hoverpod MkI (L).
steps: Speak to Advisor Nina at the IFN Supply Depot (waypoint below) and take A New Home.
Visit the medical, weapon, armor and clothing stores as directed.
Collect the starter items and the hoverpod.

cost.text: Free.

score.rationale: Free starter kit and vehicle, second step in the recommended route.

warnings: April 2025 fix: if your A New Home chain is stale, the official remedy was to abandon and retake it, and abandon the old original starter quest if active, to receive the hoverpod. Only use this for that case.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Islands Beyond the Horizon (puny islands)
activities.summary: Ask Nina, then Commander Sertris at Resolute Firebase. This opens four low-HP auto-loot hunting islands for Carabok, Gallard, Hornet and Monura. Take the A New Home bonus kill chain too if it is offered.
steps: Ask Advisor Nina about Islands Beyond the Horizon.
Go to Commander Sertris at Resolute Firebase (waypoint below).
Hunt on the four puny islands (Carabok, Gallard, Hornet, Monura).
If offered, take the bonus kill chain.
rewards: Access to four low-HP auto-loot hunting islands
requirementsText: The research's route does this after A New Home

cost.text: Ammo and decay for low-HP targets.

score.rationale: Third step in the recommended route; cheap, safe early hunting.

warnings: The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Welcome to IFN Basic Training
activities.summary: Complete IFN Basic Training, then see Drill Sergeant Edmund Kinzel to start the long Oratan Payback daily track.
steps: Complete Welcome to IFN Basic Training.
See Drill Sergeant Edmund Kinzel (waypoint below) to start Oratan Payback.

cost.text: Unknown.

score.rationale: Opens the main long-term hunting daily track.

warnings: Whether planet-born or returning avatars face identical IFN gates is unverified.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Arkadia Protection Duty (unlimited rifle)
activities.summary: The shorter gear goal: ask Nina for Arkadia Protection Duty, fill its hunting progress meter and claim an unlimited Herman LAW-R Mk.1. Bigger targets fill the meter faster.
steps: Ask Advisor Nina for Arkadia Protection Duty.
Hunt until the progress meter is full. Larger targets advance it faster.
Claim the Herman LAW-R Mk.1.

cost.text: Ammo, decay and healing to fill the meter. Compare the extra cost of bigger targets with a longer low-maturity hunt.

score.rationale: Gets a lasting weapon sooner than the long IFN track, at some combat cost.

activities.title: Visit Arkadia Underground
activities.summary: Arkadia Underground is reached from any surface teleporter by choosing it in the top dropdown. Pick up the Oratan Insignia contract from the Underground Mysterious Traveller and pair it with a matching surface Oratan Payback hunt where the objective counts.
steps: At a surface teleporter, select Arkadia Underground in the top dropdown, then its entry teleporter.
Take the Oratan Insignia contract from the Mysterious Traveller (waypoint below).
Pair it with Oratan Payback on the surface where the objective counts for both.
Sal'Diresh Vaults need keys and treasure maps; since 2025 Professor Felix Dorne in 8 Coins HQ manages the key missions.
rewards: Access to the Underground and its Insignia contracts

cost.text: Teleporter travel; Sal'Diresh needs keys and maps.

score.rationale: Fourth step in the recommended route; free side trip that adds Insignia stacking.

warnings: Check Sal'Diresh key and treasure-map requirements before going in.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Travel to Arkadia Moon
activities.summary: Arkadia Moon is a separate space destination. The 2019 Arkadia 16.1 update added a Moon-to-Arkadia teleporter for 7 PED, replacing the 2018 need to fly back. Its current fee, and any reverse surface-to-Moon link, need checking after later fare changes.
steps: Fly to the Moon's space waypoint (below).
Confirm a drop-off and a way back before carrying valuables.
Check the PvP map before travelling.
rewards: Access to the Moon (Gamma Portal, extractors, backpack, Genetic Labs)

cost.text: Travel to the Moon; the Moon-to-Arkadia teleporter cost 7 PED in 2019 (current fee unverified).

score.rationale: Fifth step in the recommended route; opens the Moon daily and backpack, but travel details are unverified.

warnings: Current Moon docking, local teleporter options, cargo rules and hunting/mining tax need field verification.
The 7 PED Moon-to-Arkadia fee dates from 2019; a reverse route is unconfirmed.

activities.title: Adventurer's Backpack (Laura, Moon)
activities.summary: On the Moon, wear the qualifying Hazmat or Smuggler gear and see Laura for the Adventurer's Backpack. You collect seven meteorite samples at the waypoints in the mission guide.
steps: Wear the qualifying Hazmat gear (from the extractor daily) or Smuggler gear.
Talk to Laura (waypoint below).
Collect seven meteorite samples at the guide's waypoints and hand in.
requirementsText: Qualifying Hazmat gear or Smuggler gear

cost.text: Unknown.

score.rationale: Useful one-time item once you have the Hazmat or Smuggler gear.

warnings: The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.summary: The Mysterious Stranger at Celeste Quarry asks you to gather surface fruit, stones and dung. Low gear cost.
steps: Take the mission from the Mysterious Stranger at Celeste Quarry (waypoint below).
Gather fruit, stones and dung on the surface.
Hand in.

cost.text: Little beyond time.

cooldown.resetNote: Listed as a daily; exact timer length and trigger pending.

score.rationale: First repeatable in the recommended order; cheap.

warnings: Duration and trigger pending.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Hunting Insignias (Mysterious Travellers)
activities.summary: Mysterious Travellers on the surface, in the Underground and on the Moon offer hunting categories. Pick the category that matches the creature you already plan to hunt and fill its meter for Arkadia Insignias.
steps: Pick up the Underground Oratan option before doing matching surface hunts.
At a Mysterious Traveller, choose the category that matches your planned target.
Fill the meter and hand in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for the hunt.

currencies.name: Arkadia Insignia
currencies.note: Save for Lunar Plate upgrades, particle blueprints or Sicarius Nest entry.

cooldown.resetNote: Listed as a daily; exact timer length and trigger pending.

locations.label: Mysterious Traveller on the surface (no waypoint in the research)

score.rationale: Second in the recommended order; stacks with hunting you already do.

warnings: Exact timer trigger pending.

activities.title: Oratan Payback (IFN daily hunting)
activities.summary: A long daily hunting track run from IFN Challenge Terminals. Each stage needs a set number of daily completions against a stage-specific Oratan; stage 1 needs seven. The guide's stage counts add up to 343 daily completions for stages 1-9, ending with an unlimited dropship.
steps: Use an IFN Challenge Terminal (one waypoint below).
Start with Prospector Puny near the waypoint below.
Hunt the stage's Oratan once per daily cycle until the stage count is reached.
Check the current journal for the exact timer.
rewards: Later stages: skills and attribute tokens

cost.text: Daily ammo and decay. The optional Secret Camp consumes Arkoins.

currencies.name: Arkoin
currencies.note: Only for the optional Secret Camp.

activities.limits: 343 daily completions across stages 1-9 per the guide's counts.

cooldown.resetNote: Listed as a daily; exact timer length and trigger pending. Confirm in the current journal.

score.rationale: Third in the recommended order; long but leads to skills, attribute tokens and a UL dropship.

warnings: The 343 total is calculated from the guide's stage counts, not stated by the partner.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Mining Insignias and ACA Mining Point Challenge
activities.summary: Pick one resource-category mining mission from a Mysterious Traveller, ideally a resource you already plan to mine. It can be done anywhere in the Arkadia system, with one Traveller mining daily active at a time. Also take Clive Forester's separate ACA Mining Point Challenge at Celeste Quarry.
steps: Choose a resource category from a Mysterious Traveller.
Take the ACA Mining Point Challenge from Clive Forester in the Celeste Quarry Managers Office (waypoint below).
Mine the chosen resource anywhere in the Arkadia system and hand in both.
rewards: 1, 2 or 3 Arkadia Insignias depending on category

cost.text: Probes and mining decay.

currencies.name: Arkadia Insignia
currencies.note: Save for Lunar Plate upgrades, particle blueprints or Sicarius Nest entry.

activities.limits: One Traveller mining daily active at a time.

cooldown.resetNote: Listed as a daily; exact timer length and trigger pending.

locations.label: Clive Forester, Celeste Quarry Managers Office

score.rationale: Fourth in the recommended order; worth it for miners, probe spend otherwise.

warnings: Exact mission clocks pending.

activities.title: Crafting Insignias (particles)
activities.summary: Choose a particle crafting assignment at one of the three Mysterious Travellers. Insignias and the particles you make feed the lab and plate path.
steps: Pick a particle crafting assignment at a Mysterious Traveller.
Check material cost and blueprint availability first.
Craft and hand in.
rewards: Particles for the lab and plate path

cost.text: Crafting materials.

currencies.name: Arkadia Insignia
currencies.note: Save for Lunar Plate upgrades, particle blueprints or Sicarius Nest entry.

cooldown.resetNote: Listed as a daily; exact timer length and trigger pending.

score.rationale: Fifth in the recommended order; depends on materials and blueprints.

warnings: Trigger pending.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: P-TECH Extractors Daily Maintenance (Moon)
activities.summary: Milo at Gamma on the Moon sends you around ten extractors, then a Monura hunt. Pick no plan for ammo, or a Hazmat clothing plan that completes after a set number of runs.
steps: Talk to Milo at Gamma (waypoint below).
Choose no plan for ammo, or a plan: hardhat 1, gloves 2, boots 3, mask 5, suit 7 completions.
Interact with the ten extractors along the guide's waypoint loop.
Do the Monura objective and hand in.
rewards: 2 PED Universal Ammo, or progress toward a Hazmat piece

cost.text: Travel around the loop plus the Monura hunt.

cooldown.resetNote: 24 h repeat per both guides; trigger (acceptance or completion) unverified. The app's timer starts when you mark it done.

score.rationale: Sixth in the recommended order; steady ammo or Hazmat gear needed for the backpack.

warnings: Older accounts end at the extractor stage and omit the added Monura hunt; the exact Monura count varies or is unverified.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.title: Seven-day Insignia challenge (Mysterious Stranger)
activities.summary: Take the Mysterious Stranger's seven-day challenge before doing your eligible dailies. It counts sets of dailies across the surface, Underground and Moon over seven days, and the days do not have to be consecutive.
steps: Accept the challenge from the Mysterious Stranger before doing eligible dailies.
Read the current objective before planning trips.
Complete the required dailies within seven days.

cost.text: Unknown.

currencies.name: Arkadia Insignia
currencies.note: Save for Lunar Plate upgrades, particle blueprints or Sicarius Nest entry.

cooldown.resetNote: Seven-day challenge; acceptance rules, per-region counting and reset trigger pending.

score.rationale: Last in the recommended order; bonus Insignias for dailies you already do.

warnings: Exact acceptance restrictions, counting per region and reset trigger pending.

activities.title: Spend Arkadia Insignias
activities.summary: Save Insignias for a targeted Lunar Plate upgrade, the Mysterious Merchant's particle blueprints or Sicarius Nest entry. Kayla at the Genetic Labs on the Moon takes a Pure Particle Sample Mk4 for first entry; repeat entry costs one Heavy Duty Particle or, for Smugglers, 5 PED of Arkoin.
steps: Pick one goal (Lunar Plate upgrade, particle blueprints or Sicarius Nest) before spending.
Check Genetic Labs entry costs with Kayla before entering.
rewards: Plate upgrades, blueprints or instance access

cost.text: Insignias; Genetic Labs entry: Pure Particle Sample Mk4 first, then one Heavy Duty Particle or 5 PED of Arkoin (Smugglers).

currencies.name: Arkadia Insignia
currencies.note: On plates, blueprints or instance entry.

currencies.name: Arkoin
currencies.note: 5 PED of Arkoin for Smuggler repeat entry.

score.rationale: Keeps Insignias for a planned upgrade.

warnings: Entry costs are from the August 2026 guide; check before entering.

activities.title: Arkoins and the Arkoin Broker
activities.summary: Arkoins are separate from Insignias. The Arkoin Broker at the IFN Supply Depot sells clothes, armor and BLP/plasma weapons, and Arkoins also pay for optional secret camps and some instance fees.
steps: Compare broker gear with what you own.
Keep a budget for planned instance entries.
Check cargo classification before carrying Arkoins through space.
rewards: Gear from the broker; access to secret camps and some instances

cost.text: Arkoins.

currencies.name: Arkoin
currencies.note: Broker gear, secret camps and some instance fees.

score.rationale: Planning tip; avoids spending Arkoins on gear you already have.

warnings: Cargo classification of Arkoins is unverified.

activities.title: IFN Special Operations
activities.summary: Captain Darius on the Moon starts recruitment. You train across all three regions to earn IFN Spec Ops armor pieces and access to Sicarius Nest for upgrades. Treat it, and the Smuggler laboratory, as deliberate combat spending.
steps: Talk to Captain Darius (waypoint below).
Train across surface, Underground and Moon.
Use Sicarius Nest for upgrades.

cost.text: Significant combat spend across three regions.

score.rationale: Long, combat-heavy armor track for later.

warnings: A player guide warns that instance kills do not progress the Moon stage that says 'any mob'.
The source shows these coordinates with the label 'Waypoint'.

activities.summary: Viceroy armor hand-ins and upgrades, and keyed instances, are optional. Check which piece you get and whether it binds before giving up materials. Deeds are optional investments.
steps: Check the piece and binding before surrendering materials.
Use the current offers and mission journal.
